# BDE Ventures

> Operator-led advisory for founders building the next iteration of the internet.

BDE Ventures works with founders at the intersection of blockchain, AI, infrastructure, and consumer platforms and brands. The site’s founder is Brian D. Evans, Founder and Managing Partner.

## Primary page

- https://bde.io/ : firm positioning, focus areas, operating model, founder biography, contact, and links to BDE Dispatch.
